He graduated with honors in 2008. He is currently providing medical service as an Associate Medical Director for CareNow Urgent Care. He has a diverse background in Full spectrum of Family Medicine, worked in multiple different settings including Hospital, Clinic, Nursing Home, Home Health and served as a Medical Director for Heart to Heart Hospice. Dr. Nguyen earned his Bachelor of Science in Medical Technology at University of Washington, Seattle WA. He then received his Doctor of Medicine from Ross University School of Medicine, Roseau, Dominica. He completed his internship and Residency at University of Iowa in Mason City. Besides practicing traditional medicine, Dr. Nguyen has special interest in Aesthetic procedures. He has more than 10-year experience in injectable aesthetic including Botox, Dermal Filler. Dr. Nguyen is also an expert in the fields of Natural Bio-Identical Hormone Replacement and has been providing hormone optimization for thousands of patients. In addition, Dr. Nguyen offers PRP/ Stem Cells injections for multiple purposes including: Joint, neck, back pain Facial rejuvenation Hair restoration Sexual wellness including: ED treatment for males Incontinence and Orgasm Enhancement for Females Before Medical school, Dr. Nguyen was an artist and a professional photographer. He enjoys multiple sports including Tennis, Pingpong, Taekwondo, Snowboard and also plays Guitar, Piano and Flute. Dr. Nguyen truly believes that “Healthy is Beauty”. He and his staff are constantly focused on their mission to help patients “look better, feel better, and live better”. Lisa Cooper With over twenty years of experience in nursing and as an accomplished esthetician, Lisa Cooper works with talented hands to enhance the beauty of her clients. After earning an advanced diploma from The American Institute of Intradermal Cosmetics, she is able to artistically create personalized treatments and procedures catered specifically to your skincare needs and desires. Also, she excels at explaining procedures to her clients in a thorough and understanding manner. Lisa currently resides in the North Dallas area with her husband and two of her four children. She has a witty charm and down to earth likability; honest with her clients and tells them exactly what they need and what they do not. Above all Lisa keeps her clients best interest in mind. Botox injections are non-surgical and minimally invasive. The Botox Cosmetic solution is an FDA-approved substance that safely smoothes specific face muscles that cause wrinkles. Botox Cosmetic injections can be repeated as needed when facial wrinkles reappear and usually last 3 to 4 months. Early and regular Botox treatments can have a preventative effect, keeping existing wrinkles from worsening, and suppress the formation of new wrinkles in treated areas.
